shortDefinition.en: Unwanted variation in the recorded or rendered image, influenced by light statistics, electronics, and processing.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 记录或呈现图像中的非预期变化，受光的统计特性、电子系统和处理影响。

en: The ISO number alone is not a complete physical explanation of noise.
zh-cn: ISO 数字本身不是噪点的完整物理原因。

example.en: A shorter exposure can reduce collected light and worsen signal-to-noise ratio even when ISO compensates brightness.
example.zh-cn: 较短曝光可能减少集光并降低信噪比，即使 ISO 补偿了亮度。

sources.title: What Is ISO in Photography? — Photography Life
sources.supports: Noise is not explained simply as ISO adding light or being its sole cause.
